press_references.value: Claude Desktop can now easily run Qwen, DeepSeek and Kimi models — after Ollama’s first effort stalled

product_launches.description: Ollama launched a Claude Desktop integration that allows users to select and run Ollama-hosted models, including Qwen, DeepSeek, and Kimi, within Anthropic’s desktop application.

The article publishes a Python-based "research_agent.py" script that uses Ollama's chat, web_search, and web_fetch APIs to implement a programmable multi-step research assistant capable of web-based queries and synthesis.

press_references.value: Ollama Now Runs Faster on Macs Thanks to Apple's MLX Framework

product_launches.description: Ollama released preview version 0.19 of its app for Apple silicon Macs, adding MLX-based acceleration, smarter memory management, and support for Alibaba's Qwen3.5 model to significantly speed up local AI inference.

press_references.value: Ollama’s Turbo Update : Features Speed, Power, and Privacy

product_launches.description: Ollama launched its Turbo Update, introducing a redesigned interface, Turbo Mode for faster AI processing, expanded model support, enhanced privacy controls, and token-based usage plans, making AI interaction more accessible and secure for users.

press_references.value: Code Reviews: Building an AI-Powered GitHub Integration

product_launches.description: A developer built and launched an AI-powered code review assistant that integrates GitHub with a locally hosted LLM (qwen2.5-coder on Ollama), providing automated code review suggestions and a web interface for managing feedback.

press_references.value: Build a Local AI-Powered Document Summarization Tool

product_launches.description: An AI-powered tool for summarizing documents using local LLMs, supporting PDF and text files.
